description: This Java class defines an immutable implementation of the AcknowledgementLabel interface, providing methods for creating and manipulating acknowledgement labels based on string values. It includes methods for equality, hash code, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableAcknowledgementLabel
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the AcknowledgementLabel interface, representing an acknowledgment label with a string value.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance from a CharSequence.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the label string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the label string.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, considering class and label content.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the label.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the label.
